description: NaMg₁₄SbO₁₆ is alpha Po-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmmm space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.16-2.30 Å. There are eight inequivalent Mg sites. In the first Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.20 Å. In the second Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, corners with four MgO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.18 Å. In the third Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.33 Å. In the fourth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.15-2.21 Å. In the fifth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-8°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.15-2.20 Å. In the sixth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-3°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.26 Å. In the seventh Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MgO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-3°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.26 Å. In the eighth Mg site, Mg is bonded to six O atoms to form MgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MgO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one SbO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-6°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.27 Å. Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, and edges with twelve MgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.29 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na and five Mg atoms to form ONaMg₅ octahedra that share corners with six ONaMg₅ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-8°. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Mg and one Sb atom to form OMg₅Sb octahedra that share corners with six ONaMg₅ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. In the third O site, O is bonded to five Mg and one Sb atom to form OMg₅Sb octahedra that share corners with six ONaMg₅ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. Both O-Mg bond lengths are 2.27 Å. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent OMg₆ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-9°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and four Mg atoms to form ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to four Mg and two equivalent Sb atoms to form OMg₄Sb₂ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₅Sb octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six ONa₂Mg₄ octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six OMg₄Sb₂ octahedra and edges with twelve OMg₅Sb octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the ninth O site, O is bonded to one Na, four Mg, and one Sb atom to form ONaMg₄Sb octahedra that share corners with six ONaMg₄Sb octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, four Mg, and one Sb atom to form ONaMg₄Sb octahedra that share corners with six ONaMg₄Sb octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-7°. There are two shorter (2.18 Å) and two longer (2.21 Å) O-Mg bond lengths. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six ONaMg₄Sb octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to six Mg atoms to form OMg₆ octahedra that share corners with six ONaMg₄Sb octahedra and edges with twelve ONaMg₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-5°. There are two shorter (2.13 Å) and two longer (2.18 Å) O-Mg bond lengths.
